summary: Frontend smoke test on FitMe Pro dashboard. Dashboard loads with 30 cards and measurement panel visible, but multiple critical blockers found: calculators do NOT unlock even after all valid measurements are entered (counter stuck at 0/30), a global overlay ('.grain' wrapper on <html>) intercepts pointer events blocking theme toggle / category chips / details links / unit toggle, search filter does not filter cards, and localStorage persistence loses non-age fields on reload.
passed: Measurement panel visible with all input fields
Age, height, weight, waist, hip, neck, wrist inputs accept values (visible in screenshot)
Sex select (shadcn) opens and 'Male' is selected

failed.issue: After entering age=30, sex=Male, height=175, weight=72, waist=82, hip=96, neck=38, wrist=17 (all visible in inputs), the counter still shows '0 / 30 unlocked' and calc-value-bmi never appears. BMI should be ~23.5. Result cards do not render values.
failed.evidence: Screenshot shows all inputs populated but hero counter reads '0 / 30 unlocked'. calc-value-bmi selector timed out (element never rendered).

failed.issue: Clicks on nav-theme-toggle, unit-imperial, dash-category-basic, and calc-details-bmi all fail with '<html lang="en" class="dark"> intercepts pointer events'. Likely the .grain overlay div (App.js wrapper) or a pseudo-element has pointer-events:auto over the whole viewport.
failed.evidence: Playwright retries for 8s and reports html intercepts pointer events for every interactive element outside the input panel.

failed.issue: Typing 'BMI' in dash-search leaves all 30 cards visible. Filter is not applied.
failed.evidence: After fill('dash-search','BMI') and 500ms wait, calc-card-* count is still 30.

failed.issue: After reload, age=30 persists but height input is empty. Other fields likely also not persisted (only partial).
failed.evidence: After page.goto('/'), input-age value='30' but input-height value=''.

failed.issue: dash-category-basic renders as a <div> (not button) and is blocked by the html-level overlay, so category filtering cannot be exercised.
failed.evidence: Click on data-testid=dash-category-basic times out due to html intercept.

failed.issue: Cannot verify /calculator/bmi route, JSON-LD, or SEO content because calc-details-bmi link is blocked by same pointer-events overlay.
failed.evidence: Click on calc-details-bmi times out (html intercepts).

action_items: Fix the top-level overlay swallowing pointer events. Check the .grain class in App.css (likely has ::before/::after with pointer-events:auto covering full viewport, or the .App div has pointer-events set incorrectly). Set pointer-events:none on the decorative grain layer.

Debug why measurements do not unlock calculators. Verify MeasurementContext state updates on input change, and that ResultCard renders when values are valid. Counter reads 0/30 despite all inputs populated — likely a controlled-input/onChange or validation gate not firing.
Fix search filter in Dashboard.jsx — currently does not filter calc-card list on dash-search input.
Ensure MeasurementContext writes ALL fields (height, weight, waist, hip, neck, wrist, activity, goalWeight, sex) to localStorage — currently only age (or partial) persists.
Once overlay is fixed, re-test: theme toggle, unit metric/imperial toggle, category chips, details links, JSON-LD on /calculator/bmi, copy button toast, print button, responsive layouts.
